import sys,glob,os,itertools; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); import cadcmp_all as K
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, LineString, Point
from shapely.ops import unary_union
for f in sorted(glob.glob(r'C:\VIsual Studio Projects\KOR.Drafter\work\_acceptance\2143\gen\out\*.f2k')):
  M=K.f2k(f)
  pads=[(n,Polygon(p).buffer(0)) for n,p,s in M['floors'] if s in('Col_Stiff','Stiff1')]
  slab=unary_union([Polygon(p).buffer(0) for n,p,s in M['floors'] if s not in('Col_Stiff','Stiff1')])
  ov=sum(1 for (a,A),(b,B) in itertools.combinations(pads,2) if A.intersection(B).area>0.5)
  wl=sum(1 for w in M['walls'] for n,P in pads if LineString([w['a'],w['b']]).intersection(P.buffer(-0.5)).length>1)
  off=sum(1 for n,P in pads if not slab.buffer(0.5).contains(P))
  print(os.path.basename(f), 'floors',len(M['floors']),'pads',len(pads),'pad-pad overlaps',ov,'wall lines through a pad interior',wl,'pads off the slab',off,'cols',len(M['cols']),'walls',len(M['walls']))
"
